description: Reset computer_repl's persistent JavaScript runtime: every binding — handles, variables, functions — is discarded, and the next computer_repl call starts fresh and returns the API reference again. Nothing on the surfaces changes: no tab, window or app is closed. This runtime's target ownership is released after any active call stops. Use it only when the runtime is wedged or its state is wrong, never as a way to "start over" on the screen.
name: computer_repl_reset
